display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-04-Two-Stage-D2-07 Novel approaches towards next-generation battery concepts, leveraging the enabling role of innovative advanced materials (BATT4EU and IAM4EU Partnerships) – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-04-Two-Stage-D2-07 Novel approaches towards next-generation battery concepts, leveraging the enabling role of innovative advanced materials (BATT4EU and IAM4EU Partnerships)
executive_summary: Researches next-generation battery materials and cell-level concepts in one of three areas. Area C covers stationary grid storage and energy-intensive industry. Eligible research consortia can propose an area for mobility, grid storage or energy-intensive industry. The topic budget is EUR 48 million, with around EUR 4.8 million expected per project. Opening 2026-12-15. First stage 2027-04-14, invited full proposals 2027-10-07. Both submission deadlines are at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Climate, Energy and Mobility Work Programme, pp. 101–104, describes the eligible work in Scope. General Annex B allows funded Dutch consortium participation. Area C explicitly calls for system-level integration potential and multi-hour grid flexibility, which can support TSO analysis of integration requirements. This supports Type 1 and C1.3. Both project dates are null because the call states no start, end or duration.
